criteria.requirement: Add String.replace_value(value,*,fallback=False), returning a detached String that retains original single/multiline and basic/literal quote kind and an independent copy of trivia. Encode semantic value through existing from_raw so escaped characters and leading multiline newlines roundtrip. If literal style cannot represent the value, propagate InvalidStringError unless fallback=True, then switch only to the matching-width basic style. Preserve original node and str.replace semantics; validate arguments.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
